title: episode_config/v1
description: Non-frozen, operator-authored episode configuration. The runtime normalizes this document to the frozen bundle_manifest.run_config object before replay evidence is sealed. Legacy golden-fixture spellings remain accepted so the hand-computed M0 oracle is executable without changing its frozen bytes.

schema.description: Runtime input schema discriminator. It may be omitted by an in-process caller; authored JSON files should include it.

leverage_cap_gross_lev_1e4.description: Account gross-leverage cap in 1e-4 leverage units.

drawdown_kill_switch_1e8.description: Peak-to-current drawdown threshold in 1e-8 ratio units.

lookback_bars.description: Operator bar-lookback override; null uses the pack recommendation.

funding_prints.description: Operator funding-print lookback override; null uses the pack recommendation.

lookback.description: Legacy golden-fixture spelling. Direct lookback_bars and funding_prints fields take precedence when both forms are present.

response_deadline_ms.description: Per-attempt response deadline recorded in the normalized run config.

decision_timeout_ms.description: Legacy alias for response_deadline_ms. The direct response_deadline_ms field takes precedence.

seed.description: Recorded deterministic seed. The V1 engine consumes no randomness.

cost_profiles.description: Profiles to simulate. V1 requires primary and stress_2x; additional pack-declared profiles remain an input-level extension but are not accepted by the current V1 runner.

cost_profile.description: Legacy fixture inspection selector. Either valid value normalizes to both mandatory V1 profiles.

turnover_cap_1e8.description: Cumulative turnover cap in 1e-8 ratio units; null disables the gate.

parse_failure_retries.description: Harness retry count. V1 executes at most the first retry; this field is intentionally absent from the frozen replay run_config.

market_params_restated.description: Golden-fixture-only hand-check aid. The pack manifest is authoritative and the runtime ignores this object.

note.description: Golden-fixture-only human note ignored by the runtime.
